text:
alex: Heads-up — APAC demo load test next Tue 09:00 PST. Need to confirm GPU pool for the canary run.
maya: Which pool size are we planning? original ask was 10x A100 80GB for 2 hours, right?
sam: Correct. +1 for A100. Vendor said H100s are delayed but might be available as a fallback.
alex: @sam can you ping procurement to lock 10x A100 or give ETA? we need a firm answer by EOD Friday.
procurement-bot: Purchase request PR-4821 created by @sam — awaiting vendor confirmation (vendor: CloudVertex). Status: pending quote.
maya: Quick quota check — we currently have GCP project qps: A100 quota = 8 in apac-east1 (per earlier quota ticket). So 10 won't fit without a quota bump.
sam: Filed quota request with cloud support: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/12345 (ticket 8842). They said 48-72h typical.
alex: OK — plan B: can we mix 8x A100 + 4x h100r (spot) and gate H100s behind network isolation? risk is kernel compat.
rachel: H100 spot evict risk is high during business hours; for a demo I'd prefer reserved A100s.
maya: If quota bump is slow, can we do 8 A100 reserved and run a staged canary: 2-phase load test where phase1 uses 8 nodes and phase2 ramps to 10 using short-lived spots?
sam: That seems reasonable. I'll update the runbook and PR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deployments/pull/291
alex: Also double-check the runtime config: set max_batch_tokens=1024 and enable prefix_cache for the demo model. If we hit OOM, reduce sequence to 512.
maya: Adding the config snippet:
```
gpu_pool: apac-demo-a100
nodes: 8
runtime:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  prefix_cache: true
```
sam: On the vendor side, CloudVertex contact (Anita) replied: "Quote attached, delivery ETA 2026-03-28 if PO today" — forwarding email to procurement.
alex: If PO timeline slips, fallback is to run in US-west with cross-region routing. That adds ~80ms latency, is that acceptable for the demo?
rachel: 80ms is okay for the demo; but mention to product that latency will be higher. Also need to add opt-in for telemetry in the console.
maya: Who's owning the final confirmation? @sam to lock PO / quota; @alex to approve runbook / cross-region fallback; @rachel to notify product.
sam: Ack. I'll chase CloudVertex and cloud quotas. Will post update in this thread before EOD Fri :thumbsup: 
alex: Thanks — tagging @will-sre in case we need emergency spot blending during the run.
will-sre: I'll stand by and prep spot blending scripts, can flip the autoscaler threshold to 0.6 during the test.
vendor-bot: CloudVertex quote uploaded to procurement portal: Q-7782. Anita (CloudVertex) — +1d hold for PO.
alex: Great. If we don't have firm A100s by 18:00 Fri we'll commit to the 2-phase run with spots. Please add to runbook and notify product.
sam: Noted. I'll update PR-291 and drop a short checklist in the runbook: "lock quota", "PO sent", "canary config updated", "product notified".
maya: Minor ask — can someone review the PR when it's ready? cc @julien for perf knobs.
julien: Happy to review once it's up.
alex: Thanks everyone. Closing loop here — will check back Friday afternoon.
